=== Notes ===
Note <span id='N1998'>N1998</span>. 

'''•''' If Thomas RAMAGE was her 2nd son, her father might have been Thomas MURRAY, but there’s a 5-year gap between Archibald and Thomas, so maybe another boy died before Thomas was born -- as 3rd son, Thomas would likely be named after his own father, Thomas.
Don’t find a Jane RAMAGE born in the 1770s or 1780s in the 1851 census in Lanarkshire, but there was one b. 1798 in the Upper Ward, Lanarkshire..
